Continuation Test
Count: 16  Wall: 2  Level: Beginner

[1 – 8] RHUMBA BOX, JUMPS
1 & 2 Step left to left side, right beside left, forward on left.
3 & 4 Step right to right side, left beside right, back on right.
5-6 Jump forward (right, left). Hold and Clap.
7-8 Jump back (right, left). Hold.

[9 – 16] WEAVE, TURN, WEIGHT NOTES
1-2 Cross rock left over right. Recover onto right.
3-4 Step left to left side, turn 1/2 left stepping right to right side
5-6 Walk forward left, right
7-8 Step forward left, turn moving weight to right foot
